description: This PHP class 'WorkWeekService' within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin provides a service layer for managing 'WorkWeekDao' data access objects, including lazy instantiation and retrieval of the DAO in a Human Resource Management context.

classes.name: WorkWeekService
classes.description: Service class providing access to WorkWeekDao with lazy initialization.

methods.name: getWorkWeekDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of WorkWeekDao, creating it if it does not already exist.
